backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a product catalog backend with CRUD operations, session-based and Internet Identity authentication, role-based access control, and blob storage integration for an Indian e-commerce affiliate site.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two regression fixes for Version 117: restoring product display in the ProductGrid component and fixing admin login (both custom auth and Internet Identity) in the AdminLogin component.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one- to two-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's React components, hooks, and pages.
frontend/CLOUDFLARE_CDN_SETUP.md: Step-by-step guide for configuring Cloudflare CDN settings (minification, Brotli, caching, image optimization, HTTP/3) to improve performance of the RecomNow India website.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Documents a production deployment failure caused by a missing favicon asset and provides a comprehensive go-live checklist covering static assets, build verification, routing, service worker, and SEO checks.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with Google Analytics, SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, geo-location tags, structured data for the organization, and preload hints for critical assets like the hero banner and logo.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_ACTION_PLAN.md: Action plan targeting Lighthouse scores of 90+ mobile and 95+ desktop by addressing large JS bundles, unoptimized images, render-blocking CSS, and missing cache headers through phased optimizations including Cloudflare configuration.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZATION.md: Documents all performance optimizations implemented for the RecomNow India frontend, covering critical CSS inlining, image optimization, code splitting, service worker caching, Core Web Vitals tracking, and React Query configuration to achieve PageSpeed scores above 85.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Standard robots.txt allowing all crawlers and pointing to the sitemap URL.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing the single homepage URL with daily change frequency and highest priority.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for HTML/API calls, with versioned caches, pre-caching of critical assets on install, and cleanup of old caches on activate.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that handles client-side routing by pathname, lazy-loads ProductsPage, AdminPage, and SitemapPage, and conditionally renders the Header and Footer (hidden on admin and sitemap routes).
frontend/src/components/admin/BlogManage: Placeholder admin component that displays a notice indicating blog management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/admin/Newsletter: Placeholder admin component that displays a notice indicating newsletter management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductMan: Admin panel component for full CRUD management of products, supporting add/edit/delete via dialogs with category, pricing, and featured fields.
frontend/src/components/admin/SitePagesM: Placeholder admin component that displays a notice indicating site pages management functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login/registration form component supporting both username/password and Internet Identity authentication methods, with password strength validation and error handling.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard component with tabbed navigation for Products, Blog, Newsletter, and Site Pages management sections, supporting logout for both custom session and Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/AmazonBanner.tsx: Placeholder component that renders nothing (returns null), likely a stub for a removed Amazon banner feature.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Modal dialog that displays a static 'Blog feature unavailable' message, indicating blog functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/BlogTeaser.tsx: Memoized component that renders nothing (returns null), serving as a stub after blog functionality was removed.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Memoized footer component with newsletter signup form, quick navigation links, social media icons, trust badges, and affiliate disclosure for RecomNow India.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Memoized sticky header with logo, site title, and navigation links (Home, Products, Admin Panel) using client-side pushState routing.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Memoized hero banner section with a gradient background, headline, Shop Now/Browse Collection buttons that scroll to products, and trust badges.
frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.t: Lazy-loading image component using IntersectionObserver for viewport-based loading, WebP format preference with PNG fallback, and priority/eager loading support.
frontend/src/components/PageModal.tsx: Modal component that displays static content for Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and Contact pages based on a pageKey prop.
frontend/src/components/PasswordStrength: Displays a visual strength bar and feedback list for a given password using the validatePasswordStrength utility, showing Weak/Medium/Strong states.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Paginated product grid with category filtering (fashion/jewellery subcategories), product cards showing image, price, discount badge, and featured label.
frontend/src/components/SocialProof.tsx: Displays a customer testimonials grid with star ratings and an auto-rotating 'Recently Bought' ticker showing recent purchase activity.
frontend/src/components/Spinner.tsx: A simple animated SVG spinner component used as a loading indicator.
frontend/src/components/TrustBadges.tsx: Renders a configurable set of trust badge images (e.g., Kolkata-based, Amazon Associates, SSL secure) in horizontal or vertical layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor instance, using Internet Identity when authenticated or an anonymous actor otherwise, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Zustand store with persistence for managing a custom username/token auth session, including session expiry validation after 24 hours.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAuth.ts: Provides React Query mutations for user registration, login (storing session token), and logout against the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Provides two utility hooks: one for debouncing a value and one for debouncing a callback function, both with a configurable delay.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login status, identity persistence, and delegation validity.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating products and user profile data via an ICP actor, including admin checks and cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a gold-and-navy color scheme in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/web-vitals.d.ts: TypeScript declaration file providing type definitions for the web-vitals library's metric interface and reporting functions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin page component that conditionally renders a login form, access-denied message, loading state, or the admin panel based on Internet Identity and custom session authentication status.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Simple page component that renders a header banner and the ProductGrid component for browsing all products.
frontend/src/pages/SitemapPage.tsx: Page component that generates and writes a basic XML sitemap to the document on mount, covering the home and products URLs.
frontend/src/utils/delayedScripts.ts: Utility that defers injection of third-party scripts until 3 seconds after the page load event to improve Core Web Vitals.
frontend/src/utils/passwordValidation.ts: Provides password strength scoring, validation logic, and a match-check utility based on length, character variety, and special characters.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL and hash query parameters, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash without reloading.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with oklch-based color tokens for gold and navy palettes, custom border radii, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite configuration for a React frontend targeting ICP (Internet Computer), setting up proxying to local or mainnet ICP host, path aliases, environment variable injection, and optimized production build with manual chunk splitting for React, ICP, and UI vendor libraries.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for 'RecomNow India' tracking two known regressions from Version 117: the Products page not displaying products and the admin login facility being broken, with corresponding fix feature entries referencing REQ-1 and REQ-2.
